blog-discord-bot-meta-description: A custom-built, multilingual Discord bot for event signups, translations, and administration, built with Python, discord.py, and SQLite.
blog-discord-bot-heading: Discord Bot for Events & Community Management
section-discord-intro: Discord is a popular platform for communities with text, voice, and video chats. My bot automates tasks on Discord servers, makes MMO-focused event organization easier, and supports multilingual communication, so community managers save time and keep an overview.
section-signup-screenshots-text: Here is what event registration looks like directly on the Discord server:
section-core-features-text: My bot combines four bots in one: event signups for MMOs, translation, admin tools, and a news bot. It is operated through slash commands and buttons directly in Discord. The main features:
section-technical-architecture-text: The bot is written in Python with discord.py and runs in Docker on Linux. The four bots are developed and operated as one shared project. New features run in a separate test environment first before they go to the live system.
section-challenges-text: The biggest challenge was combining several bots cleanly in one project and reliably preserving the state of running events, even across restarts. On top of that came multilingual support and the template logic, which called for clean data structures and well-thought-out command handling.
section-conclusion-outlook-text: The bot is in use by more than 120 users and makes everyday community management on Discord servers noticeably easier. It is a hands-on project in which I apply architecture, persistence, and automation to a real use case.
feature-1: Event signup: Ready-made templates, signup with multiple accounts, separate threads, and status options, built for MMO events.
feature-2: Translation: Messages are translated at the push of a button directly in the chat, so multilingual communities can come together.
feature-3: Admin tools: Tools for managing members, roles, and alt accounts, plus activity statistics.
feature-4: News bot: A dedicated bot for community news.
arch-list-1: Four bots in one shared codebase
section-commands-text: A selection of the slash commands that members and event leads work with:
cmd-signup: /signup Sign up for events. Automatically starts an event template, so recurring events are set up in seconds. With multi-account support, separate threads, and status options.
cmd-signup_custom: /signup_custom Create custom events independent of templates.
cmd-list_events: /list_events All events on the server at a glance.
cmd-translate: /translate /translate_section Automatically translate single messages or whole sections.
cmd-create_translation_button: /create_translation_button Adds buttons with language flags below a section. Clicking a flag delivers the translation.
cmd-help: /help Quickly opens a bug ticket if something goes wrong.
